title: The 3 Best Electric Can Openers for Seniors
h1: The 3 Best Electric Can Openers for Seniors
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for electric can openers for seniors, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at electric can openers for seniors using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Smooth Touch Electric Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Large single lever control, Smooth-edge cutting, Extra-tall opening.
strengths: One large, easy-to-find lever is simpler to operate than multi-button designs
Cuts along the side, leaving no sharp edge on the lid or can
Corded countertop design needs no battery changes to remember
limitations: Requires an outlet within reach of the counter
No auto-stop indicator light, so listening for the motor to stop is the cue

products.name: Cuisinart Deluxe Electric Can Opener CCO-50N
products.blurb: Key specs: Single-touch automatic operation, Automatic stop when the cut is complete, Nonslip wide base.
strengths: Automatic stop removes the need to watch or listen for when the cut finishes
Nonslip base reduces the chance of the unit sliding during use
Detachable parts simplify cleaning without small tools or disassembly
limitations: Bulkier footprint than a drawer-stored battery model
Fewer long-term owner reviews than the Hamilton Beach
features: Automatic stop when the cut is complete

products.name: Black+Decker Spacemaker EC600 Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Under-cabinet mounting, One-touch lever, Frees up counter space.
strengths: Mounted permanently under a cabinet, so it's never misplaced or knocked over
Frees counter space, useful in a smaller kitchen
One-touch lever is simple and consistent once installed
limitations: One-time mounting installation may need help from another person
Fixed height may not suit every user's reach comfortably
Smallest review base of the four picks here

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
